stories.title: Syria holds talks with Israel addressing de-escalation and Israel-Turkey tensions
stories.summary: Syria said it held talks with Israel in Jordan on Sunday on de-escalation after recent Israeli strikes, and on keeping the country out of tensions between Israel and Turkey, an ally of Damascus. The high-level negotiations came after the sides in January agreed to establish an intelligence-sharing mechanism as they edge towards a security agreement. stories.title: KBO's top 2 teams set for weekend clash
stories.summary: The top two clubs in the South Korean baseball standings will be on a collision course for a crucial weekend series, as the battle for the regular-season title is heating up. The KT Wiz are clinging to first place in the Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) with a win-loss-tie record of 64-41-3, one game ahead of the Samsung Lions (65-44-2). Both clubs have won two straight games. These two rivals will square off for a three-game set starting Friday at the Lions' home, Daegu Samsung Lions Park in the southeastern city of Daegu. The Wiz have been worse against the Lions than any other opponent this season, with a 3-8-0 mark. The Lions will try to climb to the top of the standings before that crucial weekend clash. They will begin the new week with a three-game series against last-place Kiwoom Heroes (42-72-2) at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul. The Wiz will host fifth-place Doosan Bears (58-50-4) for three games at KT Wiz Park in Suwon, just south of the capital, from Tuesday to Thursday. With the top five teams qualifying for the postseason, there is some separation between the upper echelon and the bottom five of the league. The Bears enjoy an eight-game lead over sixth-ranked Lotte Giants (50-58-2), with the Hanwha Eagles (49-57-3) and the NC Dinos (48-56-2) right behind the Giants. The Bears, meanwhile, trail fourth-place Kia Tigers (60-52-2) by one game. And the Tigers are a half-game behind the LG Twins (61-50-1) for third place.
